title: Modular Process Systems
summary: Engineered modular systems combining vessels, piping and selected auxiliaries within a defined scope.
body:
Modular system supply can help coordinate mechanical equipment, piping interfaces, instrumentation allowances, quality requirements and transportation planning.

The division of responsibility between process licensor, EPC, fabricator and site contractor should be agreed early. Our proposal scope is determined by available technical data and project-specific capabilities.
seoDescription: Project-specific modular process systems, skids and integrated industrial equipment packages.
